description: This file defines a Preact component 'IslandApp' that manages notes, including loading/saving from localStorage, handling state for notes, selection, editing, and rendering child components for header, sidebar, and editor.

methods.name: loadNotes()
methods.description: Loads notes array from localStorage, parsing JSON or returning an empty array if not found or error occurs.

methods.name: saveNotes(arr)
methods.description: Serializes notes array into JSON and saves it to localStorage.

methods.name: handleSearchInput
methods.description: Updates the search state with user input.

methods.name: handleNoteSelect
methods.description: Sets the selected note by ID and focuses the main panel.

methods.name: handleCreateNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with a unique ID and sets it as selected for editing.

methods.name: handleDeleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID and updates selection accordingly.

methods.name: handleEditNote
methods.description: Enables editing mode for the current note.

methods.name: handleSaveNote
methods.description: Saves the current note's title and content, updating the notes list.

methods.name: handleTitleChange
methods.description: Updates the title of the selected note.

methods.name: handleContentChange
methods.description: Updates the content of the selected note.
